svg.data-weight-note: 6.35 kg (14 lb) base system, no power supply or fan tray; 8.62 kg (19 lb) fully loaded with 2 power supplies and fan tray
svg.data-acoustics: 55.6 dBA typical and 58.6 dBA maximum sound pressure; 62.6 dBA typical and 65.6 dBA maximum sound power (ISO 7779, 25 C)
svg.data-throughput: 131 mpps for IPv4, 110 mpps for IPv6
svg.data-airflow-cfm: 28 CFM at low speed, 44 CFM at full speed
svg.data-power-current-max: AC: 4 A at 120 VAC, 2 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-power-supply-options: PWR-C49E-300AC-F (300 W AC, reversed airflow); no DC supply is available for the -F
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: data sheet: "supports 10 Gigabit Ethernet SFP and SFP+ on all the four uplinks". The installation guide's Table 1-1: 4 1-GB or 10-GB uplink ports, each needing an SFP or SFP+ transceiver.
svg.data-reset: recessed on the front panel; needs a pointed object
svg.data-regulatory: Products bear CE Marking, indicating compliance with the 89/336/EEC and 73/23/EEC directives
svg.data-emissions: FCC Part 15 (CFR 47) Class A, ICES-003 Class A, EN55022 Class A, CISPR22 Class A, AS/NZS 3548 Class A, VCCI Class A, EN55024, ETS300 386, EN50082-1, EN61000-3-2, EN61000-3-3
svg.data-nebs: GR-63-Core NEBS Level 3, GR-1089-Core NEBS Level 3
svg.data-etsi: ETS 300 019 Storage Class 1.1, Transportation Class 2.3, Stationary Use Class 3.1
